NDT software in Richmond, California: built around refinery turnarounds and Bay Area plants

NDT software in Richmond, California starts with one fact: the Chevron Richmond Refinery is one of the largest refineries on the West Coast, and its maintenance and turnaround cycles set the rhythm for many inspection contractors in western Contra Costa County. The Atlantis ERP solution gives a Richmond NDT company one system for technician certifications, calibration, crew dispatch, reports, quoting and invoicing, so peak turnaround weeks do not break the office.

The wider market runs along the Carquinez Strait and the northern shoreline of the Bay. There is refining and renewable-fuels conversion work at Martinez and Rodeo, chemical and industrial gas plants, tank terminals, pipelines, the Port of Richmond's bulk and vehicle terminals, bridge and infrastructure work on crossings such as the Richmond-San Rafael Bridge, and fabrication shops serving the whole East Bay. Richmond also has a shipbuilding heritage from the wartime Kaiser shipyards, and some marine and fabrication work still happens on the waterfront.

Regulation here is tighter than most places. Cal/OSHA's process safety management standard for petroleum refineries, Title 8 Section 5189.1, adopted after the 2012 crude unit fire at the Richmond refinery, puts heavy emphasis on mechanical integrity and damage mechanism reviews. Contra Costa County and the City of Richmond have their own Industrial Safety Ordinances, and the Bay Area Air Quality Management District regulates emissions. None of that is managed by the ERP. What the ERP does is keep a contractor's side of the record clean: who inspected what, qualified to what level, with which calibrated instrument, to which procedure revision, reviewed and approved by whom.

ERP for NDT companies in Richmond: surviving turnaround season

An ERP for NDT companies in Richmond needs to scale from a few daily technicians to a large turnaround crew and back without losing track of certifications, instruments or hours. The Atlantis ERP is configured for inspection work, with apps for NDT Reports, Certificates, Procedures, Team Assignments, Asset Management, Project, Timesheets, Quotations and Invoicing.

Typical Richmond contractors are a mix: established regional firms with dozens of technicians on long-term plant contracts, and smaller specialist firms doing PAUT, TOFD, RT and PMI that are called in for turnarounds. Both face the same pinch point. Refinery contractor management asks for proof of qualification before badges are issued, every instrument needs a current calibration certificate, and daily reports must be reviewed and returned quickly so the owner can close out equipment and put units back in service. A spreadsheet-and-email setup copes on a normal week and fails in the third week of a turnaround. The Atlantis ERP puts the records in one place so the office can keep up with the field. The full list of apps is on the ERP apps overview.

Technician certification tracking software for refinery badge and onboarding checks

Technician certification tracking software in Richmond has one job before a turnaround: prove that every technician on the list is currently certified for the methods they will perform. The Atlantis Certificates app computes each certificate's status as active, expiring soon, expired or revoked and flags anything within 90 days.

Each record holds scheme (SNT-TC-1A, CP-189, ISO 9712, PCN, CSWIP or other), level, method, certifying body, issue, expiry and renewal dates, industry sector, OJT hours, training hours, exam results and the certificate file. Vision tests record Jaeger J1/J2 near vision, far vision, colour perception, contrast, examiner, clinic and expiry. The employee NDT profile adds highest level, methods certified, radiation safety training, radiation badge number and medical fitness expiry, which matters for radiography crews working inside a refinery fence.

When you add travelling technicians for a turnaround, their certificates go in once and the Expiring Soon and Expired menus show gaps immediately. Daily checks create warning tasks, email alerts go to named recipients with your chosen look-ahead and resend interval, and Timesheets warns if someone books hours while their certificate is not valid. Company certifications, such as ISO 9001 or owner-required accreditations, are tracked with their own alert days. See Certificates.

Crew dispatch software for turnarounds and daily plant calls

Crew dispatch software for Richmond has to run two schedules at once: the turnaround roster planned months ahead, and the daily call-outs that keep coming from other plants. Atlantis Team Assignments moves jobs through planned, dispatched, in field, submitted and closed and blocks double-booking of technicians and equipment serial numbers.

The technician availability calendar records assigned, leave, training, sick and unavailable days and blocks overlaps, fed by Time Off. Each technician shows current assignment, utilisation and next available date, so you can see who can be released for a daily job in Martinez without weakening the turnaround crew. Jobs carry site GPS coordinates and mobilisation and demobilisation dates. The Project app records client PO, contract, methods, codes, scope and acceptance criteria, assigned equipment and technicians, and safety induction and work permit fields. Tasks carry method, technician, component, result, indication and defect counts, plus procedure and WPS references, so the day's progress on a unit is visible in one list rather than in a stack of paper. Views include calendar, kanban and list. See Team Assignments and Project.

NDT reporting software for refinery piping, vessels and exchangers

NDT reporting software during a turnaround needs to get reports from the unit to the owner's inspector fast, with the right signatures. Atlantis NDT Reports runs every report through draft, in progress, review, approved and sent, with inspector, reviewer and approver signatures and a third-party or authorized inspector name and signature.

There are 17 report types with their own numbering sequences, which covers typical refinery scopes: UT with probe calibration table, UT thickness readings by direction, PAUT focal laws, TOFD, RT with source, technique, IQI type and placement, computed radiography, MT, PT, VT, IRIS and ECT for exchanger tubes, PMI for alloy verification, hardness and PWHT records, ferrite and holiday/coating tests. Weld and job lines record defect type and orientation; overall results are acceptable, not acceptable or acceptable with remarks. References include work order, request, WPS, contract, drawing numbers, procedure and standard.

If the owner specifies its own Excel data sheets, Atlantis maps your fields to their cells so templates fill automatically. Technicians use the offline field app inside units and vessels, with photos and on-screen signatures, and sync later. The ERP records readings; engineering assessment of those readings remains with the owner's inspection program. For clients who want to see results on the equipment, Digital Twin Reporting Software and Atlantis Digital Twins place indications and thickness trends on a 3D model. See NDT Reports.

Calibration management software for turnaround-scale equipment pools

Calibration management software is under most pressure when a turnaround doubles the number of instruments in use. The Atlantis Asset Management app tracks every flaw detector, PAUT unit, thickness gauge, probe, yoke, PMI analyser and RT item by serial number, and Team Assignments warns when assigned equipment is out of calibration.

Calibration records store provider, certificate number, standard, range, uncertainty, accredited-lab flag, result and next due date, and the certificate register keeps lab accreditation numbers, PDFs and valid, expiring or expired status with alerts. Reservations with clash prevention let you lock equipment to the turnaround in advance. Issue and return runs through supervisor and manager approval with condition recorded both ways. Lifecycle covers rented out, which is useful when you hire extra units for peak weeks, and rental rates can be recorded. The maintenance log handles repairs, firmware updates and probe replacements, and consumables carry reorder levels so you do not run out of couplant or developer on night shift. In Purchase, calibration labs are vendor types with accreditation number and expiry. See Asset Management.

Procedure control for owner and contractor procedures

Richmond contractors often work to owner-approved procedures that must be submitted and accepted before work starts. The Atlantis Procedures app keeps document number, revision, method, scope, material, applicable standard such as ASME Section V, and acceptance criteria in one register.

Workflow runs draft, submitted, reviewed, approved and published, plus rejected and archived, with prepared, reviewed and approved by names and dates. Approved revisions are locked and each revision is stored as a snapshot, so when an owner asks which revision a report was performed to, the answer is exact. The AI-assisted first draft helps your Level III prepare new procedures quickly; the Level III still reviews and approves. Email reminders prompt approvers. See Procedures.

NDT quoting and invoicing software for refinery contracts

NDT quoting and invoicing software for Richmond needs to match the detail refinery contract administrators check. Atlantis Invoicing carries NDT project, job or PO number, site, invoice type and industry sector, with labour, equipment and consumables subtotals and lines by cost centre, method, equipment serial, technician, rate type and days or hours.

Timesheets capture inspection, travel, standby and setup time with approval, billable flag and rate multiplier, so shift differentials, overtime and standby while waiting for permits are billed rather than lost. Quotations carry job type, site, dates, codes and NDT service products by method, with a branded PDF, online acceptance and conversion to a sales order. Expenses handles per diems and travel for out-of-area technicians, re-billable to the job. The financial dashboard shows revenue, cost of sales, gross margin, operating expenses, EBITDA and outstanding invoices across twelve months, which is useful when turnaround invoices sit in approval for weeks. See Quotations and Invoicing.

Inspection management software in Richmond: smoothing the turnaround cycle

Inspection management software can also help fill the gaps between turnarounds. The Atlantis CRM tags leads by service line, NDT service type and industry sector, estimates technicians and days, and scores leads 0 to 100, so you can target fabrication shops, terminals, utilities and infrastructure owners during quiet months. Leads import from CSV, business cards are scanned into leads, and drip campaigns can be drafted by an AI model running on your own server. See CRM.

Affordable customizable ERP for inspection companies in Richmond

An affordable customizable ERP for inspection companies in Richmond gives you refinery-grade records without enterprise-scale cost or rigidity. Atlantis quotes on request after reviewing your methods, clients and integration needs.

Most Richmond firms begin with Certificates, Asset Management, Team Assignments and NDT Reports ahead of a turnaround, then add Timesheets and Invoicing. The open REST API connects to SAP, Maximo, NetSuite, QuickBooks or any system that accepts API connections, scoped per implementation. Request a quote for your Richmond team.

Implementing the Atlantis ERP in Richmond

Timing matters. Atlantis NDT, led by founder Anoop Rayavarapu, an ASNT NDT Level III, runs implementation remotely and plans go-live around your turnaround calendar rather than in the middle of one.

  1. Twelve or more weeks out: load technicians, certificates, vision tests and radiation records; load instruments and calibration certificates.
  2. Eight weeks out: build report templates, including owner data sheets; load approved procedures and revisions.
  3. Four weeks out: set up Team Assignments, reservations and Timesheets; run daily plant jobs through the system.
  4. Turnaround: field crews on the offline app, office on review and approval.
  5. After: invoicing, dashboards and lessons learned.

Atlantis also offers ASNT SNT-TC-1A-based NDT training, an eLearning portal and the Practical NDT 3D simulator to bring trainees up before peak season. Plan your go-live around your next turnaround.

Frequently asked questions

What is the best ERP for NDT companies working Bay Area refinery turnarounds?

One that links certifications, calibration, dispatch, reports and billing. The Atlantis ERP does this in one system configured to your forms and owners' requirements.

Does the ERP handle refinery mechanical integrity or damage mechanism reviews?

No. Those belong to the owner's programme. The ERP records your inspection reports and business data; engineering assessment and inspection planning stay with the owner's inspection group.

Can we add travelling technicians quickly for a turnaround?

Yes. Add their certificates, vision tests and profiles once; status and alerts compute automatically and dispatch blocks anyone double-booked.

Can reports include an authorized inspector signature?

Yes. Reports carry inspector, reviewer and approver signatures plus a third-party or authorized inspector name and signature.

Does it integrate with a client's Maximo or SAP?

The open REST API integrates with SAP, Maximo, NetSuite, QuickBooks or any system that accepts API connections, scoped per implementation.

How is it priced?

Quote on request. The Atlantis ERP is affordable, accessible and fully customizable.
